settings.title: Settings
settings.youtubeWhich: Which add-on plays the YouTube links you send to %1.
settings.mode.smart.about: The YouTube add-on first. After it fails, SendToKodi plays them for the next 30 minutes, then the YouTube add-on gets another go.
settings.mode.youtube-first.about: The YouTube add-on every time; SendToKodi takes over when Kodi says it failed.
settings.mode.sendtokodi-only.about: The YouTube add-on is never used.
settings.mode.youtube-only.about: No fallback: when the YouTube add-on fails, Kodi shows its error.
settings.smartWaiting: The YouTube add-on failed recently, so SendToKodi is used until %1.
